findings.title: Full config-flow wizard invents a DHW tank and a second zone the user never affirmed
findings.claim: Of the 6 completion paths of the shipping initial config flow, submitted untouched, the 2 full-wizard ('Continue setup') paths create entries whose first coordinator cycle models a 200 L DHW tank. The 'Enter thermal values directly' path also runs the two-zone model. No answer on either path said the house has hot water or two zones; the quick-setup paths answered 'no' produce neither.
findings.mechanism: The presence rules thermal_model._dhw_enabled_from_config (tank volume, thermometer or windows present) and the two-zone 'auto' rule in ThermalParameters.from_config (any zone key present) meet forms that always submit those keys. async_step_dhw offers no 'no hot water' answer and pre-fills dhw_tank_volume=200 and dhw_windows. async_step_zones, whose docstring calls it an 'optional step', pre-fills four zone keys. Only quick_setup.derive writes the explicit dhw_enabled / two_zone_mode flags. On the thermal path the plan covers 26.45 kWh against 22.24 kWh for the stated plant, with predicted_cost 19.289 against 11.796, in the same cycle.

evidence.unit: flow completion paths publishing unaffirmed plant (of 6)
evidence.contention_note: up to 4 usable.py grid shards ran on the box during some re-runs; the count is deterministic

perturbation.change: --perturb explicit_presence: _dhw_enabled_from_config honours only an explicit dhw_enabled, and from_config defaults two_zone_mode to off (the one-line shape of the fix for both rules)

findings.metric_definition: Initial-flow completion paths (DFS over menus, forms untouched, quick-setup plant answers 'no') whose entry's first _async_update_data publishes dhw_enabled with a dhw_plan tank trajectory, or two_zone_enabled, with no affirming answer.
findings.phenomenon_property: A plant (DHW tank, second zone) is modelled only when an answer on the user's own setup path affirmed it. No form default and no key presence alone may turn one on.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: config_flow.py async_step_dhw and async_step_zones: ask 'has DHW' and 'two zones', or write explicit dhw_enabled / two_zone_mode from the answers the way quick_setup.derive does, so that untouched defaults no longer act as presence. Update tests/entities.py's pinned 'turns hot water on anyway' check.

non_findings.claim: All 864 installation x heat-pump cells pass the D12.M4 bar. Setup completes, the cycle does not raise, an optimal plan is published, no entity property raises, the entities of each omitted plant stay unavailable, no DHW, PV or wood plan is invented, and no service call targets an unconfigured entity.
M5 null control: the fully-mapped reference plant passes.
M6: dropping any one of the 20 optional *_entity slots from the reference plant leaves setup, plan and entities usable.
The grid instrument moves: forcing DHW power into the published plan fails every dhw=none cell and leaves the reference plant untouched.
non_findings.value: failing_cells=24/24 (invented_dhw_plan); --grid ref under the same perturbation: 0

non_findings.claim: Frequency control mode with an empty kW-Hz map writes no frequency, so it invents no compressor command.

leads.what: On an install with no tank, buffer or slab sensor, the data dict publishes dhw_temperature 55.0, buffer_tank_temperature 40.0 and slab_temperature 22.0, which are the ThermalState constructor defaults. The entities stay unavailable, but any card or diagnostics reader of coordinator.data would show fabricated temperatures (D4/D8).
